_purpose: Play the benchmark game start to finish and assert every link of the chain: the cube is picked up, the plate presses under it, the door opens, and the exit is reached. This has to pass before any bug-injection result means anything - a failure has to be the injected bug and not the harness. Needs 00-build to have run once.

steps._note: Nothing has happened yet. Reading all four flags first means a later true is something this run caused, not something left over.
Walk onto the cube. Overlap attaches it to the pawn, snapped to the pawn's origin so it travels with them.
Carry it onto the plate. The plate reacts to the CUBE, not to the player, so this only presses if the pickup really worked.
The door bound to the plate's OnPressed at BeginPlay, so this is a cross-actor dispatcher firing, not a tick check.

teardown._note: Always runs, including after a failed assertion, so a broken run does not leave a session open for the next one.
